features.label: Expected goals
features.note: How many goals their shots would usually produce, going by where and how they were taken.

features.label: Expected assists
features.note: How many assists their passes would usually produce, going by the chances they set up.

features.label: Key passes
features.note: Passes that led straight to a shot.

features.label: Big chances created
features.note: Passes that set up a clear chance to score.

features.label: Final third passes
features.note: Passes completed in the attacking third of the pitch.

features.label: Ball recoveries
features.note: Times they picked up a loose ball.

features.label: Headers won
features.note: Duels in the air they won, mostly headers.

archetypes.name: Progressive wing-back
archetypes.about: A full-back who bombs on: creates chances and gets the ball into the final third.
archetypes.stats: Well above average for expected assists, big chances created and final third passes, below average for expected goals and shots.

archetypes.name: Wide dribbler
archetypes.about: Takes defenders on, usually from out wide, and gets shots away.
archetypes.stats: Well above average for dribbles completed, shots and expected goals, below average for clearances and interceptions.

archetypes.name: Stopper centre-back
archetypes.about: Defending first: headers, clearances and interceptions.
archetypes.stats: Well above average for clearances, headers won and interceptions, below average for key passes and final third passes.

archetypes.name: Ball-winning midfielder
archetypes.about: Breaks up play and wins the ball back: tackles, interceptions, recoveries.
archetypes.stats: Well above average for tackles won, ball recoveries and interceptions, below average for big chances created and expected assists.

archetypes.name: Creative playmaker
archetypes.about: Runs the game from midfield and feeds the ball into the final third.
archetypes.stats: Well above average for final third passes, key passes and expected assists, below average for clearances and headers won.

archetypes.name: Clinical finisher
archetypes.about: Lives in the box. Takes lots of shots and scores goals.
archetypes.stats: Well above average for expected goals, goals and shots, below average for ball recoveries and interceptions.

archetypes.name: Creative forward
archetypes.about: An attacker who sets others up: key passes, big chances and assists.
archetypes.stats: Well above average for expected assists, key passes and big chances created, below average for clearances and headers won.

archetypes.name: Defensive full-back
archetypes.about: A full-back who stays home: tackles, interceptions and clearances.
archetypes.stats: Well above average for tackles won, interceptions and clearances, below average for shots and expected goals.

y: more expected goals and headers won
more ball recoveries and final third passes
